name: Character Name (Source, outfit)
credit: Where the art came from and under what terms. Local use only if it is a rip.
_check_first: Overlay two poses at 1:1 and compare the HEADS before writing any of this. Same size means the poses share a scale and can be mixed. Different size means the source draws that pose at another zoom, no alignment can fix it, and only one pose family may be used.
_breathe: Amplitude is a property of the art, not the widget. The old hardcoded 1.05 is one pixel of squash on a 16px sprite and seven on a 150px human figure, where it reads as inflating rather than breathing. periodMs is the HALF cycle - the animation auto-reverses - so 2600 is about 11 breaths a minute.
_group: Two states with the same group may cross-fade into each other; different groups hard-cut. Group by BODY POSE: dissolving arms-down into arms-crossed is a four-armed ghost, not a transition. A state with no group never fades.
_pick: Optional, and it decouples the timeline from the file list. One entry per STEP, each listing which file numbers (1-based, in this state's own frames order) may appear at that step. The renderer never picks the same one twice running. Without it a state holds one identical face for ever, which is the tell that it is a loop rather than a character. Note frameMs is then measured in steps, not files.
_still: A state may be one frame with frameMs 0 and it will sit still, which is legal and sometimes right. Beware next to a blinking idle: the character appears to freeze the instant that state is entered. Give even the momentary states a blink.
_nudge: Any state may add "nudge": [dx, dy] in source pixels to shift that pose inside the register canvas.
